desc: Derive the reformulation: total cost = sum over segments of prefixNums[r]*(segment cost sum) + k*suffixCost[segment start] per segment.
Implement prefix sums for nums and cost; suffixCost[j] = totalCost - preCost[j].
Implement dp array of size n+1 with dp[0]=0 and the O(n^2) transition.
Test against both provided examples (expect 110 and 985) and edge cases: n=1 → (nums[0]+k)*cost[0]; no-split; all-splits; brute-force small random cases.
Review complexity (O(n^2) time, O(n) space) and finalize code in the starter format with List import.
